description: Authorizes an application for your AWS Directory.
mitreAttackSubTechniques: T1496.004 - Resource Hijacking: Cloud Service Hijacking

incidents.description: Threat Actors Using AWS WorkMail in Phishing Campaigns

securityImplications: Attackers might use AuthorizeApplication to authorize WorkMail on the directory of an organization they set up for phishing; an unexpected call can reveal that email infrastructure is being created in the account.
